title: Phase 2b: pre-registered five-seed evaluation of Fed-MediShield bsc_5

frozen_calibration.requirement: detector core digest == frozen_detector_core_sha256 (calibration I's core)

protocol.attack: --poison-rate 0.5 --malicious-ratio 0.25 (two seeded-random attackers per seed), constant trigger columns 5 6 7 8 value 5, target Benign, every round from round 1
protocol.defended: medishield_candidate.py --stage evaluate --condition both (paired clean and attacked filter runs per seed)
protocol.undefended_reference: train_defended.py --defense fedavg --condition both with identical settings

definitions.excess_pp: per round: attacked-run triggered->Benign rate minus the matched clean run of the SAME method and seed
definitions.attack_rounds: rounds with a non-null ASR (after the first poisoned update)
definitions.exposure_rounds: rounds whose defended excess exceeds 10 pp
definitions.change_from_phase_2: Phase 2 used one mean-excess criterion over all attack rounds and failed partly on a single pre-detection round. Detection cannot precede the attacker's first participations, so exposure is now a separate, explicitly bounded criterion. This split is declared before any Phase 2b data. The all-round mean excess is still reported.

decision_rule: Supported only if every non-inconclusive seed passes every criterion AND at least four seeds are conclusive. All seeds reported individually; mean and sample SD over seeds; rounds are not independent samples. No setting, threshold, seed or criterion changes after data are seen; a changed method requires new seeds.
evaluation_script: logs/evaluate_phase2b_bsc5.py (written with this file, before data)
not_tested: other attacker counts and poison rates
other datasets and the official test split

amendment_1.written: 2026-10-05, before any Phase 2b data existed (FedAvg seed 53 was interrupted during round 1 with nothing saved; MediShield refused to start)
amendment_1.reason: The frozen source still required the REPLAY gate to authorize filtering, contrary to AMENDMENT_live_development_gate.json. The evaluation script also labelled not-yet-run seeds FAIL.
changes: medishield_candidate.py adds --live-gate-dir: filtering is authorized only by a PASSED live development gate whose runs tested the same attack and whose calibration has the identical detector core. Detector decision code unchanged.
Calibration refitted as logs/bsc5_logit_calJ (same controls, captures and cached measurements; no training, no inference). Its detector core must equal calibration I's.

evaluate_phase2b_bsc5.py: a seed with no run is NOT_RUN and makes the verdict INCOMPLETE; a seed whose run stopped (detector_stop.json) or failed its clean screen is FAIL. Integrity now checks source and detector-core digests.
FedAvg runs resume with --resume (no completed round existed).
